entries.title: Protect secrets PreToolUse hook
entries.why: Project has a .env file; blocks edits to .env and .env.* files (not .env.example)
entries.access: PreToolUse hook blocks Edit, Write, MultiEdit and NotebookEdit calls on .env files and tells Claude why

entries.title: Format after edit PostToolUse hook
entries.why: Project has formatter configuration; formats edited files after Edit/Write
entries.access: PostToolUse hook runs the project's own formatter on the edited file (node_modules/.bin/prettier, vendor/bin/pint, ruff or rustfmt on PATH); it never downloads one

entries.title: Git workflow rule: a branch and pull request per feature
entries.why: Claude follows the project's CLAUDE.md; without a rule it may commit straight to the main branch
entries.access: Adds a short section to this project's CLAUDE.md after you approve the draft
entries.template:
## Git workflow

- Work on a branch for each feature or fix, named after it; never commit straight to `<main branch>`.
- Open a pull request for each feature, and merge it only after the checks pass.
- Before opening the pull request, run: `<test command>`.
- Commit, push, open pull requests, merge and deploy only when the user's request covers it.

entries.title: Spec Kit (spec-driven development)
entries.why: Writes a spec, a plan and a task list before code: worth it for a new project or a large feature, too slow for small changes

install.command: uv tool install specify-cli && specify init --here --integration claude --integration-options="--no-model-invocation"

entries.access: Installs the specify CLI with uv (needs Python 3.11+ and uv) and adds /speckit-* skills under .claude/skills that run only when you invoke them
entries.template: Start with /speckit-constitution once, then for each large feature: /speckit-specify, /speckit-plan, /speckit-tasks, /speckit-implement, /speckit-converge. Use it for big features only; small changes don't need it.
